[[Cuba]] competed at the [[2000 Summer Olympics]] held in Australia's largest city, [[Sydney]]. 229 competitors, 147 men and 82 women, took part in 135 events in 24 sports.<ref name="sports-reference">{{cite web |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/CUB/summer/2000/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200417042458/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/countries/CUB/summer/2000/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=17 April 2020 |title=Cuba at the 2000 Summer Games |access-date=29 February 2012 |work=sports-reference.com}}</ref>
